onboarding.voiceWelcome: Welcome to SafePay. You are on the home screen. Double tap Speak Balance to hear your balance, or use the MoMo Services tiles to send money, hear your statement, buy airtime, or cash out.
onboarding.welcomeBody: Welcome to SafePay. SafePay reads your money out loud, and your secret PIN is never spoken. This short setup works by voice and by touch.
onboarding.micBody: May SafePay use the microphone? It listens while the app is open, so you can speak your commands.
onboarding.micGranted: The microphone is allowed. SafePay can hear your commands.
onboarding.micDenied: No problem. You can allow the microphone later in Settings.
onboarding.micPermanent: The microphone is turned off for SafePay. Allow it in your phone settings, then open SafePay again.
onboarding.listeningBody: While SafePay is open, the microphone stays on. You never have to find a button. Say gyae, or stop, any time you want SafePay to be quiet.
onboarding.nextHint: Double-tap to continue to the next step
onboarding.contactsBody: Later, SafePay can find a number when you say a name, for example send money to Ama. When you first use it, SafePay will ask for permission. Your contacts stay on your phone.
onboarding.talkbackTitle: How do you move around the screen?
onboarding.talkbackBody: How do you want to move around the screen?
onboarding.srOff: Your screen reader is off. SafePay will speak for itself.
onboarding.micTestBody: Now say anything. For example: hello SafePay.
onboarding.micTestRetry: I did not hear anything. Say it again, a little louder.
onboarding.voiceTestOk: Good. You can change the volume at any time.
onboarding.voiceTestNo: Turn the volume up, and listen again.
onboarding.bioBody: SafePay confirms every payment with your fingerprint. Your PIN is never spoken.
onboarding.bioReady: Your fingerprint is set up and ready.
onboarding.bioNone: This phone has no fingerprint sensor. SafePay will use your voice confirmation instead.
onboarding.bioNotEnrolled: No fingerprint is enrolled yet. You can add one in your phone settings, under Security. SafePay will use your voice confirmation until then.
onboarding.bioSuccess: Fingerprint confirmed. Your payments are protected.
onboarding.bioFailed: The fingerprint did not match. You can try again any time.
onboarding.bioLockout: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
onboarding.teachBody: Three commands. Say: me sika a aka, to hear your balance. Say: kɔma sika, to send money. Say: gyae, to stop SafePay.
onboarding.teachBalance: Yes. Me sika a aka is the balance command.
onboarding.teachSend: Yes. Kɔma sika is the send money command.
onboarding.teachAgain: Try again. The commands are: me sika a aka, kɔma sika, gyae.
onboarding.doneBody: SafePay is ready. Your balance and your transactions can be read aloud, and your PIN is never spoken. Say me sika a aka to hear your balance.
onboarding.exited: Setup paused. You can run it again from Settings.
